the SNMPv3Message and HeaderData layouts (msgID, msgMaxSize, msgFlags of one octet with auth 0x01, priv 0x02 and reportable 0x04, msgSecurityModel) and the ScopedPDU

the 150-second time window; and an agent's boots at 2147483647, a boots mismatch or a time more than 150 s off puts a message outside it

the agent's order of checks on an incoming message: engine ID (step 3), user (4), security level (5), digest (6), time window (7), decryption (8). U2 to U6's counts rest on it, and the time-window Report comes before decryption, so its request-id is 0 (RFC 3412 section 7.1 step 3c)
the time-window Report goes at authNoPriv, and every other Report at noAuthNoPriv; a Report answers a readable Confirmed Class PDU, or an unreadable one with the reportable flag set
confirmed.rfc: RFC 3414 section 3.2 step 7a; RFC 3412 section 7.1 steps 3b and 3d; RFC 3411 section 2.8

confirmed.what: the PDU tags ([0] GetRequest to [8] Report) and the BulkPDU's non-repeaters and max-repetitions
GetBulk drops trailing varbinds to fit msgMaxSize and never answers tooBig

AES-128-CFB with the first 16 octets of the localized privacy key, the IV boots, time and the 8-octet salt, most significant octet first, and no padding; privacy parameters not of 8 octets are a decryption error
HMAC-SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA-512 MACs of 24 and 48 octets over the whole message with the MAC field zeroed, keys of 32 and 64 octets, localized as RFC 3414 section 2.6 with the same hash
a long-form length may use more octets than it needs, so H12 is a positive case
an OID has at most 128 sub-identifiers, each at most 2^32-1

agent.engine_id_label: form documented (S29 p. 42), MAC 02:00:00:27:31:01 SYNTHESIZED and locally administered
agent.password: a test-only password from a published seed list, as advisorytest.Key
agent.sysDescr: SYNTHESIZED text that holds no FID by default
agent.other_cells: SYNTHESIZED text that never matches the FID grammar
agent.fids_source: S29 p. 62, Tables A.3 and A.4 (documented)
agent.serves: exactly S29's list (pp. 46 to 47), as a data file with the page cited per line; anything else gets noSuchObject, and a GETNEXT past the last object gets endOfMibView
agent.time_window_first: the agent answers the client's first authPriv request, which carries boots and time 0, with an authenticated usmStatsNotInTimeWindows Report, as a real agent does, and the client sends the request again with the adopted values. Each case with authPriv requests states whether its agent does (time_window_first), because the counts depend on it (C2 on #457)

counts.datagrams: datagrams the agent received in the run, discovery included
counts.authenticated_requests: authPriv requests the agent received in the whole run, the time-window round included; given only for runs that end before the walk, since an ok run's walk adds its GetBulk requests
counts.requests: requests of one operation the agent received: requests_of where the case names it, otherwise the walk's sel27x1.snmp.entity (section 2.4); the time-window round is included

every_run: every PDU the agent receives is GetRequest or GetBulkRequest as the operation names, never SetRequest (V-M1 (b)), in the agent's own decoded log
a get names only the operation's OIDs; a walk request lies inside the subtree
msgFlags is authPriv on every message but discovery's, at most two (U12, T3)
the collector's transcript holds every message sent and received, and C8's transcript_sha256 matches it (bytes kept)
no community-based (v1 or v2c) message is ever received
the collector does not panic and reads no byte past a datagram

hostile.fuzz: the same corpus seeds C2's Go fuzz target on the client's decoder
hostile.outer_where: the discovery Report: noAuthNoPriv with a plaintext ScopedPDU (RFC 3414 section 4), which the client parses before any authentication. ScopedPDU-shaped defects (H4, H6 to H10, H14) sit in that ScopedPDU; message-shaped ones (H1 to H3, H5, H11, H13) are cut into the whole message. H15 and H16 are fields of an authenticated message, so they go on the Responses after the time-window round.
hostile.scoped_where: the ScopedPDU of every authPriv Response after the time-window round, encrypted and authenticated with the user's keys
